instruction: Create a Part workbench box sized 36 mm along global X, 24 mm along global Y, and 12 mm along global Z, with its lower-back-left corner at the origin so it spans X = 0 to 36, Y = 0 to 24, and Z = 0 to 12. Apply a Part Offset Shape to the box with Offset = 2 mm outward, Mode = Skin, Join type = Tangent/Arc. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
